      public static void wrap(Particle pParticle, processing.core.PVector pMin, processing.core.PVector pMax)
      wraps particle position into the box defined by pMin and pMax ( periodic boundary ). the old position is shifted by the same offset so that the velocity implied by position - old_position ( e.g in verlet integration ) is preserved.
